sentences.text: High Court Of Andhra Pradesh

Main Case No: Crl.A.No.291 of 2025
 Proceeding Sheet
Sl. Date Order
OFFICE NO. NOTE 02. 07.05.2025 Dr.VJP, J  I.A.No.2 of 2025

The instant petition under Section 389(1)
 of Cr.P.C read with Sect.430(1) of BNSS has  been filed by the Petitioner/Accused seeking to  release him on bail by suspending the sentence  imposed against him, pending disposal of the  criminal appeal.

The Petitioner is convicted and  sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for  ten years and to pay fine of Rs.5,000/- IDSI for  one month for the offence under Section  376(2)(n) IPC and also to undergo rigorous  imprisonment for one year for the offence under Section 417 IPC in Sessions Case No.30 of  2022 on the file of the Court of Special Judge  for trial of offences against women-cum-V  Additional District & Sessions Judge,
 Vizianagaram vide judgment dated 17.04.2025.

Heard Sri P.Aditya Harshavardhan,
 learned counsel for the Petitioner and  Ms.K.Priyanka Lakshmi, learned Assistant  Public Prosecutor for Respondent.

Learned counsel for the Petitioner / Accused would submit that, as per the case of the Prosecution,
the victim cut her wrist prior to lodging of the complaint and the complaint was lodged on 13.10.2020, whereas the medical evidence on record would show that, she has approached the hospital on 29.12.2020 i.e., much later than the lodging of complaint against the Accused.
Learned counsel further submit that the Petitioner was on bail all through the trial.
The Petitioner is ready to furnish sureties to the satisfaction of the Court.
Learned SL. DATE ORDER OFFICE NO.
NOTE counsel would further submit that they have merits to succeed in the appeal and it may take considerable time for disposal of the appeal.
Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor would submit that there are no criminal antecedents against the Petitioner and Court may pass appropriate orders.
The Petitioner has been in jail post conviction.
As rightly put by the learned counsel for the Petitioner, this appeal may take considerable time for disposal.
Petitioner was on bail all through the trial.

sentences.text: Considering the submissions, this Court is of the considered view to suspend the sentence of imprisonment imposed against the Petitioner / Accused on the following terms.
i) Petitioner shall execute a personal bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty thousand only) with two sureties for the like sum each to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
ii) Petitioner shall appear before the Trial Court on the First Monday of every month till the disposal of the present appeal.
iii) Learned Trial Judge may condone the absence of the Petitioner on any given date, on a petition submitted by the Petitioner with cogent reasons.
iv) In case of failure of the Petitioner to appear before the trial Court, the learned trial Judge shall report the same to the Registry.
Dr.VJP, J List the matter in regular course.
